name: Royal Belgian Chocolates
description: Handcrafted assortment of 24 premium Belgian chocolates with rich ganache fillings, topped with edible gold leaf.

name: Dark Chocolate Truffles
description: Rich, velvety dark chocolate truffles dusted in cocoa powder, with a melt-in-your-mouth hazelnut praline centre.

name: Salted Caramel Bark
description: Thin sheets of premium milk chocolate layered with buttery caramel and a sprinkle of Himalayan pink salt. Irresistibly addictive.

name: Artisan Bonbon Gift Box
description: A curated set of 16 hand-painted chocolate bonbons in exotic flavours — passion fruit, Earl Grey, rose lychee, and pistachio.

name: French Macaron Collection
description: A delightful box of 12 colourful macarons in flavours like raspberry, pistachio, vanilla, and salted caramel.

name: Rose & Lychee Macarons
description: Delicate shell macarons infused with rose water and filled with a lychee buttercream — floral, fruity, and perfectly balanced.

name: Seasonal Fruit Tower
description: A stunning tower of 18 macarons filled with fresh seasonal fruit curds — mango, passion fruit, blueberry, and strawberry.

name: Classic Vanilla & Chocolate Duo
description: Six each of signature vanilla bean and dark chocolate macarons — the perfect starting point for macaron lovers.

name: Garden Blossom Cupcakes
description: Six beautifully decorated cupcakes with buttercream frosting, edible flowers, and a soft vanilla sponge centre.

name: Celebration Cupcake Dozen
description: Twelve party-perfect cupcakes in assorted flavours — chocolate fudge, red velvet, lemon zest, and strawberry cream.

name: Red Velvet Royale
description: Six luxurious red velvet cupcakes topped with a generous swirl of cream cheese frosting and a dusting of crimson sugar.

name: Mini Cupcake Sampler Box
description: Twenty-four bite-sized mini cupcakes — the ideal party platter. Includes vanilla, chocolate, lemon, and caramel flavours.

name: Traditional Indian Mithai Box
description: An exquisite thali of gulab jamun, rasgulla, kaju barfi, and besan ladoo — made with pure desi ghee.

name: Festive Ladoo Assortment
description: A gift-worthy box of motichoor, boondi, coconut, and rava ladoo — perfect for celebrations and gifting.

name: Kaju Katli Premium Box
description: Melt-in-the-mouth cashew fudge squares wrapped in edible silver leaf — the quintessential Indian festive gift.

name: Dry Fruit Barfi Selection
description: A rich medley of almond, pistachio, and walnut barfi layered with aromatic saffron and cardamom — a true royal treat.

name: Rustic Berry Layer Cake
description: A stunning two-tier cake with cream cheese frosting, fresh seasonal berries, and hand-piped floral designs.

name: Classic Tiramisu Cake
description: Espresso-soaked sponge layers alternated with mascarpone cream and dusted with premium cocoa — an Italian classic, reimagined.

name: Chocolate Ganache Drip Cake
description: A show-stopping dark chocolate sponge draped in glossy ganache, adorned with gold-dusted macarons and chocolate shards.

name: Mango Passion Celebration Cake
description: Light vanilla chiffon layers filled with mango mousse and passion fruit curd — a tropical celebration in every slice.
